title: Western Undergraduate Exchange
text: If you are a resident of a Western Interstate Commission for Higher Education (WICHE) state (Alaska, Arizona, California, Colorado, Hawaii, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, North Dakota, Oregon, South Dakota, Utah, Washington, Wyoming), you are eligible to request a reduced WUE tuition rate of 150% of the resident rate at one of the 145 participating schools in the West. The list of participating schools includes: Arizona State University, University of Arizona, University of Northern Colorado, University of Oregon, and more. More information and the full list of participating schools can be found at: wiche.edu
